# Game Fabric

Product key: game-fabric
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/game-fabric
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/game-fabric/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/game-fabric/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- animate a football play call with receiver routes and defensive assignments
- show 11-on-11 football formation teaching on a phone
- visualize blitz pickup and offensive line blocking responsibility
- teach a running back the aiming gap and pulling guard assignment
- inspect contradictions and unknowns in tagged football film
- try synthetic scheme changes in an experimental drive simulation
- explore coach-designed playbook classroom pilot across sports
- request a research partnership for basketball soccer volleyball baseball or wrestling classroom

## Authority

public synthetic football teaching demo and multisport research discovery; no team data collection, automated outbound, real opponent report, payment or execution authority

## Boundaries

- playable football demo is constrained teaching choreography not calibrated sports prediction or complete collision physics
- all public example plays and film-review datasets are fictional or synthetic
- nonfootball sport-specific classrooms are research-stage invitations and are not presented as deployed
- no private team film, identifiable youth athletes, school records, proprietary plays, or medical information is accepted by public demos
- real opponent findings require permissioned film, independent review, and coaching signoff
- no paid pilot, verified checkout, coach adoption or external AI provider pickup has been established
- public discovery creates no outbound email, account access, payment authority or agent execution permission

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
